name: RankSEO email and password authentication
description: Verify RankSEO sign-up, sign-in, logout, authenticated public-route redirects, and unauthenticated dashboard protection using the visible browser experience.

planSteps.description: Start with a clean signed-out browser session and navigate to /auth/sign-up.
Verify the sign-up page shows the shared RankSEO header, the heading "Create your RankSEO account", Name, Email, and Password fields, a "Create account" button, and a link to sign in.
Submit the sign-up form with every field empty.
Verify inline validation prevents submission and reports that a name, valid email address, and password of at least 8 characters are required.
Enter a one-character name, an invalid email address, and a password shorter than 8 characters, then submit again.
Verify the form stays on /auth/sign-up and displays the relevant inline validation messages next to the invalid fields.
Create a unique test email address for this run, remember it with the password "RankSEO-Test-2026!", enter a valid full name, that email, and the password, then submit the form.
Verify account creation succeeds, the browser is redirected to /ai-keyword, and the authenticated AI Keyword Research page displays its heading and "Log out" button.
While still authenticated, navigate directly to /.
Verify the authenticated visitor is redirected from the landing page to /ai-keyword.
While still authenticated, navigate directly to /auth/sign-in.
Verify the authenticated visitor is redirected from the auth route to /ai-keyword.
Click the "Log out" button on the AI Keyword Research page.
Verify logout succeeds, the browser is redirected to /auth/sign-in, and the "Welcome back" sign-in form is visible.
While signed out, navigate directly to /ai-keyword.
Verify the protected dashboard route redirects the signed-out visitor to /auth/sign-in.
Enter the remembered unique test email with an incorrect password and submit the sign-in form.
Verify sign-in is rejected, an error notification is shown, and the browser remains on /auth/sign-in without exposing protected dashboard content.
Replace the password with the remembered valid password "RankSEO-Test-2026!" and submit the sign-in form.
Verify sign-in succeeds, the browser returns to /ai-keyword, and the authenticated page displays the "Log out" button.
